timeline.summary: April 22, 2026: Board approved change in location for planned wholly owned subsidiary from Spain to Italy
Studds Accessories Limited’s **Ashok Mittal** announced a Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call on **May 25, 2026, at 3:30 PM IST**, led by **Sidhartha Bhushan Khurana (MD)** and senior management.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹167.54 Cr, net profit ₹21.1 Cr.
Studds Accessories reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹634.2 Cr and PAT of ₹82.7 Cr, backed by premiumisation and capacity expansion plans.
Studds Accessories Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings conference call for Q4FY26 and FY26 results, held on May 25, 2026, via its website.
Studds Accessories completed the incorporation of its wholly owned subsidiary SMK Helmets Europe SRL in Italy with a capital of EUR 300,000.
Studds Accessories reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹634.2 Cr and PAT of ₹82.7 Cr, guided 17-18% revenue growth for FY27, and announced CFO appointment.
Promoters declared zero encumbrance on their 61.75% stake for FY26.
Sidhartha Bhushan Khurana, as Managing Director and Promoter, declared no encumbrance on Studds Accessories’ 24,302,320 shares (61.75%) for FY2026 (Nov 7, 2025–Mar 31, 2026).
Studds Accessories Limited will hold an earnings conference call on Tuesday, 3 November 2026 at 10:00 AM IST to discuss Q2 & H1FY27 results.
